greeting: Your visit had a thread running through it - and it was yours.

themes.blurb: Reflections on the journey beyond life.
Seeing beauty even in the unsettling.

your_words.object_title: Sitzgruppe des Sabu, seiner Frau Meretites und des Sohnes Isebwer
your_words.quote: A whole family, together for eternity. That moves me.
your_words.echo: The bond among family transcends time, beautifully captured in this eternal moment.

your_words.quote: The heart weighed against a feather. What would be heavier in my case?
your_words.echo: This poignant question echoes the ancient beliefs about judgment and the soul's journey.

your_words.object_title: Oberteil des Sarges der Königstochter Satdjehuti
your_words.quote: The golden face looks back at you. Beautiful and a little unsettling.
your_words.echo: The artwork’s mesmerizing gaze invites introspection about beauty and life’s mysteries.

your_words.quote: Strange that such a small animal was meant to escort someone into the afterlife. Strange and beautiful.
your_words.echo: Your thoughts on this figure remind us of the unique symbols that guide us beyond.

your_words.object_title: Würfelstatue des Bakenchons, Hohepriester des Amun
your_words.quote: So much writing on a single stone. A whole life in signs.
your_words.echo: Every inscription here tells a profound story, much like the one you reflect on.

reflective_question: How do your beliefs shape your understanding of life and what comes after it?

go_deeper.title: Scheintür der Chnumit, Gottesdienerin der Hathor
go_deeper.reason: You kept circling what comes after this life – this piece carries it further.

closing: That was your visit, in your own words. Your voice recording was turned into text and then deleted – only what you see here was kept.
